title: On a non-basis of the coinvariant algebra
summary: A conjecture arising from a question of Procesi proposes a basis of the coinvariant algebra of $S_n$ consisting of column-antisymmetrized monomials indexed by pairs of standard Young tableaux. We show that the proposed family need not even span an $S_n$-subrepresentation: for $n=8$, a generator of degree $15$ is sent outside the span by the adjacent transposition $(4,5)$. The proof is an exact finite computation with an explicit separating functional, requiring neither a rank computation nor Gr\"obner reduction.
